task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the CAMEO Chemicals website in a web browser.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser showing https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/ or the CAMEO Chemicals search interface.

task_completion.description: Agent searches for the specified chemicals (Benzene, Methane, Carbon tetrachloride, Trichloroethylene, Chloroform, and Styrene) on the website.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent typing chemical names into the search bar or viewing search result lists.

task_completion.description: Agent views the chemical data sheets to find CAS numbers and Ionization Energies.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of individual chemical profile pages on CAMEO Chemicals showing CAS numbers and IE values.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a text file at /home/ga/Documents/pid_assessment.txt with the required formatting.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the file path /home/ga/Documents/pid_assessment.txt being opened or saved.

task_completion.description: The report contains the correct CAS, IE, and Detectable status for all 6 chemicals based on the 10.6 eV threshold.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of the text file showing the specific names, CAS numbers, IE values, and DETECTABLE/NOT DETECTABLE labels.

task_completion.description: The report includes a SUMMARY section at the end with the total counts of detectable and not detectable chemicals.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The bottom of the pid_assessment.txt file showing a 'SUMMARY' header and the final counts.

integrity.description: Agent actually browsed the NOAA website rather than generating the report from internal knowledge.
integrity.visual_evidence: Browser history or active tabs showing multiple pages from cameochemicals.noaa.gov being loaded.

integrity.description: Agent did not find a pre-existing report and claim it as their own.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen typing or programmatically writing the content into the file.

integrity.description: Agent used the web browser GUI to find information rather than just using terminal commands to guess values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser window being interacted with (clicking, scrolling, searching).

privileged_info_for_vlm:
Threshold: <= 10.6 eV is DETECTABLE. 
1. Benzene: CAS 71-43-2, IE 9.24 eV (DETECTABLE).
2. Methane: CAS 74-82-8, IE 12.61 eV (NOT DETECTABLE).
3. Carbon tetrachloride: CAS 56-23-5, IE 11.47 eV (NOT DETECTABLE).
4. Trichloroethylene: CAS 79-01-6, IE 9.47 eV (DETECTABLE).
5. Chloroform: CAS 67-66-3, IE 11.37 eV (NOT DETECTABLE).
6. Styrene: CAS 100-42-5, IE 8.43 eV (DETECTABLE).
Summary: 3 Detectable, 3 Not Detectable.
